tasks.title: Country terminology and cross-country browsing
tasks.expectedResult: With Customer Country different from Product Country, browsing/purchase across the boundary keeps Customer Country as the profile value and Product Country as the product Channel value; wallet is in the customer currency; price is in the Product Country currency; any conversion is recorded; order and receipt show the correct country and currency.

mandatoryAssertions.text: With Customer Country different from Product Country, browsing/purchase across the boundary keeps Customer Country as the profile value and Product Country as the product Channel value; wallet is in the customer currency; price is in the Product Country currency; any conversion is recorded; order and receipt show the correct country and currency.
Customer Country, Product Country, shipping country, wallet currency, and payment currency are different values. The report must show each value separately and explain every conversion or rejection.

tasks.expectedResult: Overall effect image shows on the index; individual effect images show in the detail slideshow and the overall image is not one of them; selecting an effect image selects the correct design; name, SKU/design identity, country, price, currency and image associations are correct; the product completes purchase and order flow.

tasks.title: Image synchronization and local archive
tasks.expectedResult: Design and effect images exist in the local archive with a unique SKU/design directory, the overall image identified as `0`, matching design/effect identifiers, and required JSON/log metadata; the export can locate the design file from the selected effect ID. Verified on disk, not by HTTP 200.

Design/effect naming rules (overall image 0, design/effect identifier pairing, name normalization) are application requirements verified through the archive structure.

tasks.title: Standard product flow
tasks.expectedResult: A standard product (e.g. jelly glue) follows the single-price path with ordinary stock, order, receipt and platform revenue, and creates no design-fee or designer-commission record.

mandatoryAssertions.text: A standard product (e.g. jelly glue) follows the single-price path with ordinary stock, order, receipt and platform revenue, and creates no design-fee or designer-commission record.

The ordinary-product publish to purchase to receipt/order to export/shipping path is a separate path from customer-design products. It must not accidentally create design-fee or designer-commission records.

tasks.title: Custom press-on-nail purchase
tasks.expectedResult: A custom purchase lets the customer pick effect image, nail shape and finger; the order preserves design, physical product, shape, finger, size/model, Product Country, price, currency, tax, shipping and payment values.

mandatoryAssertions.text: A custom purchase lets the customer pick effect image, nail shape and finger; the order preserves design, physical product, shape, finger, size/model, Product Country, price, currency, tax, shipping and payment values.
Saved finger sizes must map to the reference shape/model and remain present in the order, export, and local design lookup.

tasks.title: Wallet and payment currency conversion
tasks.expectedResult: Where wallet currency differs from payment currency the evidence shows original amount/currency, payment amount/currency, rate, converted amount, debit order AUA to SNA to MCA, final payment state, resulting balances and ledger record; cross-currency wallet transfers (where present) and country-to-currency and country-to-rate mappings are visible.

mandatoryAssertions.text: Where wallet currency differs from payment currency the evidence shows original amount/currency, payment amount/currency, rate, converted amount, debit order AUA to SNA to MCA, final payment state, resulting balances and ledger record; cross-currency wallet transfers (where present) and country-to-currency and country-to-rate mappings are visible.
Wallet top-up and withdrawal are separate from wallet payment. Both must have input, result, currency, balance, and transaction evidence.
A transfer between two customers must show sender debit, receiver credit, currency conversion, and rejection of unauthorized self-referral credit.

tasks.title: Order display and cross-channel index
tasks.expectedResult: A paid order appears in the buyer view, designer sales view and cross-channel index (order number, Product Country, status, buyer, designer, total); detail opens in the correct Channel; unpaid anonymous abandoned carts are excluded.

mandatoryAssertions.text: A paid order appears in the buyer view, designer sales view and cross-channel index (order number, Product Country, status, buyer, designer, total); detail opens in the correct Channel; unpaid anonymous abandoned carts are excluded.
A guest who never identifies or pays may leave a cancelled/abandoned draft in Vendure internal database, but it must not appear in the buyer/designer/global business index.
A paid order must appear after the agreed payment state.
Paid buyer/designer records must appear at the correct point. Unidentified abandoned carts must not enter the global index, while paid orders must remain visible across channels.

tasks.title: Inventory and replenishment
tasks.expectedResult: Ordinary, physical blank-nail and virtual stock are handled separately; shared physical stock is consumed by both design types; zero of either makes the custom product unavailable; global and local warehouses hold stock by country/shape/model; a local order uses local stock; another country warehouse is not exposed; low-stock warning fires for physical stock only; replenishment moves global to local with an auditable result.

mandatoryAssertions.text: Ordinary, physical blank-nail and virtual stock are handled separately; shared physical stock is consumed by both design types; zero of either makes the custom product unavailable; global and local warehouses hold stock by country/shape/model; a local order uses local stock; another country warehouse is not exposed; low-stock warning fires for physical stock only; replenishment moves global to local with an auditable result.
Test zero boundaries for both stock types, physical-only warning, global-to-local replenishment, country/shape/model stock, purchase deduction, and shipment deduction.

tasks.title: Shipping and weight
tasks.expectedResult: Per-country simulated carriers and weight bands price shipping correctly by country, weight and carrier; merges and weight changes trigger recalculation and any extra payment; order, shipping record, receipt and inventory operation agree.

mandatoryAssertions.text: Per-country simulated carriers and weight bands price shipping correctly by country, weight and carrier; merges and weight changes trigger recalculation and any extra payment; order, shipping record, receipt and inventory operation agree.

tasks.title: Tax and country
tasks.expectedResult: Per-country Tax Zone and rate mapping (and dynamic update where enabled) stays consistent through product display, checkout, payment, order, receipt and post-tax split; the actual rates used are recorded from the run configuration.

mandatoryAssertions.text: Per-country Tax Zone and rate mapping (and dynamic update where enabled) stays consistent through product display, checkout, payment, order, receipt and post-tax split; the actual rates used are recorded from the run configuration.

Test country Tax Zone/rate setup and a controlled rate update through display, checkout, payment, receipt, and post-tax split. The actual supported country list must be filled in by the Contractor and evidenced.
Exchange-rate and tax-rate updates, including the scheduled behavior claimed by the implementation, must be shown through the affected user-visible and financial paths.

Verify the configured scheduled behavior for exchange rates and tax rates; record the source, frozen values, timestamps and downstream consistency. The coordinator Skill, branch-task layout and Vendure-plugin choice are implementation details, not separate acceptance tasks.

tasks.title: Account, delisting and administrative operations
tasks.expectedResult: Designer sales details are correct; customer self-delisting and authorized admin delisting work; related design files are removed or archived; the customer receipt shows correct price and tax.

mandatoryAssertions.text: Designer sales details are correct; customer self-delisting and authorized admin delisting work; related design files are removed or archived; the customer receipt shows correct price and tax.

tasks.title: Platform scripts
tasks.expectedResult: Each platform script is exercised or classified not-applicable with a reason; for each: command/invocation, input, revision, exit/error result, state change, generated files, cleanup.

mandatoryAssertions.text: Each platform script is exercised or classified not-applicable with a reason; for each: command/invocation, input, revision, exit/error result, state change, generated files, cleanup.

Every applicable script is either executed with evidence or marked NOT APPLICABLE with a concrete reason. set_commission_tiers is a Pipeline-authoring target: the Pipeline must generate or update the implementation, run it, and report the resulting tier configuration.

Every applicable script (scripts/setup_tax_rates.mjs, scripts/process_shipping_csv.mjs, tools/mark_shipped_from_csv.sh, scripts/run_export.mjs, scripts/publish_product_v11.mjs, scripts/set_craft_fee.mjs, scripts/admin_delist_products.mjs, scripts/sync_vendor_uploads.mjs, tools/check_order.sh) is either executed with evidence or marked N/A with a concrete reason.
